_meta.what: Per-enemy-tier rarity weights for the tier-gated item drop randomizer (mob_drop_fill / drop_tiers). Rows are weights over the 4 rarities; they are renormalized at runtime over the rarities each item KIND actually has (e.g. talismans have only Uncommon/Rare). Soft gating: small cross-tier tails are intentional.
_meta.tiers: Keys match nr_enemy_tags.json tier strings: grunt, miniboss, field_boss, night_boss, nightlord. 'unknown' is the neutral fallback for lots with no resolved enemy tier and for map pickups. 'chest' is applied to guaranteed map lots that already contain a Rare/Legendary (the rare-chest proxy).
_meta.epic_note: Epic tier (chaos / red 2-buff-1-debuff weapons) is DEFERRED — see dev/DESIGN_tiered_drop_rarity.md. When added it slots between Rare and Legendary.
